testcases.l0_replacement_reason: Premerge proves the same source-built bundle, strict model DSO, and public native CLI without paying for the 121-frame generation.
testcases.description: Wan2.2 TI2V-5B official maximum 720p text-to-video generation contract
testcases.test_prompt: Two anthropomorphic cats in comfy boxing gear and bright gloves fight intensely on a spotlighted stage
testcases.notes: Nightly native TensorRT plus C++ functional coverage for the exact official Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B profile: 1280x704, 121 frames, 50 UniPC steps, CFG 5, flow shift 5, 24 FPS, seed 42, and a fixed 512-token UMT5 engine. The public runtime command is Python-free. This L4 contract intentionally does not claim numerical or visual parity; promotion still requires the separate source-bound official-Wan tensor and video comparison.
